name: uibc-verifier
description: UIBC verification agent: verifies sealed evidence packages (S1-S6), returns ALLOW/DENY/HOLD gate decisions, and checks certificates. Read-only per docs/api-scope.md v1.0: it verifies packages on the operator's own disk and never writes to a caller's package.

skills.name: Verify UIBC package
skills.description: Run S1-S6 verification on a .uibc package directory. In Ed25519 mode verification needs only the DID the package names -- no key handed over out of band. Returns PASS/FAIL with per-check detail.

skills.name: Gate decision
skills.description: Return a governed decision ALLOW/DENY/HOLD (exit 0/2/3 semantics) for a package, honoring signed revocations. Disputes annotate, never silently block.
examples: gate check on a package whose owner was revoked mid-run

skills.name: Verify certificate
skills.description: Check a UIBC certificate (C1-C7) and optionally its binding to a package.
examples: verify certificate and its binding to a package

note: Self-hosted endpoint. The url above is the default local bind; the operator must substitute a reachable address before anyone integrates against it. Reachability is the operator's claim, not this file's.
